Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread && grep -RIn "Stack-buffer-overflow READ 1\|SendCommissioningGetResponse" /workspace 2>/dev/null | head -20 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/radio_receive_done.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":45,"var":"data","code":"memcpy(buf, data, frame.mLength);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a radio frame payload that will be injected into the OpenThread stack."},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/radio_receive_done.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":63,"var":"frame","code":"otPlatRadioReceiveDone(instance, &frame, OT_ERROR_NONE);","note":"The crafted frame is delivered as if it were received from the radio, entering the packet-processing path."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/core/coap/coap.cpp","function":"CoapBase::ProcessReceivedRequest","line":589,"var":"aMessage","code":"resource->HandleRequest(aMessage, aMessageInfo);","note":"The received CoAP request is dispatched to the matching resource handler based on its URI path."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp","function":"Leader::HandleCommissioningGet","line":287,"var":"aMessage","code":"SendCommissioningGetResponse(aMessage, aMessageInfo, tlvs, length);","note":"The commissioning GET handler extracts requested TLVs from the attacker-controlled CoAP payload and forwards them for response construction."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp","function":"Leader::SendCommissioningGetResponse","line":337,"var":"cur","code":"for (MeshCoP::Tlv *cur = reinterpret_cast<MeshCoP::Tlv *>(data); cur < reinterpret_cast<MeshCoP::Tlv *>(data + length); cur = cur->GetNext())","note":"The code walks nested commissioning TLVs using each TLV's length field, so a malformed dataset can make the iterator advance past the end of the buffer."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp","function":"Leader::SendCommissioningGetResponse","line":341,"var":"cur","code":"SuccessOrExit(error = message->AppendTlv(*cur));","note":"The sink dereferences the current TLV while appending it to the response; the vulnerability hypothesis is an out-of-bounds read caused by the unchecked TLV walk over malformed commissioning data.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"TLV iterator state"}]}]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('trace refreshed')
PY
cd /workspace && bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread/tests/fuzz/radio_receive_done.cpp /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
